Params: 哈哈哈，孱弱不堪!果然所谓的大天使，也不过是必须臣服在更上一级伟大力量下的存在!
“玛门”将尖锐的伞尖钉在拉斐尔胸前，反复地来回刺穿她的躯体，这个女人从前带给她的羞辱太多，她不愿意畅快地赐予这个高傲的天使解脱。
拉斐尔身上的金色符纹逐渐黯淡，胸口的空洞在一次次被撕开之后又马上自愈，敛藏在肋骨之下的核芯忽明忽暗，跟灰鸦和“玛门”的几次交锋已经消耗了她几乎所有的魔力。
濒死的天使竭尽最后一丝力量，反手抓住“施暴者”的手，但试图反抗的掌心马上也被膝上凸起的骨刺穿透了个洞。
侮辱，只是这种程度，你居然敢妄称为侮辱?!
曾经总是优雅得体的淑女已经摒弃了所有礼仪，她露骨地表达着自己的憎恨。
我只不过是把我受到的痛苦还给你十分之一，而你已经觉得是莫大的羞辱……
所谓的天使长大人，还真是养尊处优得让我觉得可笑啊!
“玛门”将伞尖用力推进核芯，天使的体内传来一阵撕裂的脆响，拉斐尔夫人终于发出了凄厉的尖叫。
你以为你现在在做什么，复仇?你们人类这些低劣的念头，真是让我失望透顶!
她齿间噙着血，在神智彻底消散之前的时间里，咬着牙吐露出最后的憎恨。
我曾给过你机会，让你在新的城镇里隐姓埋名活下去，而你，却四次三番主动招惹圣堂，为了那些无聊的欲望一次又一次把自己的灵魂当成筹码摆上牌桌。
没错，我是在牌局里出了千，但哪怕没有我，迟早也会有别的天使来出手对付你。
埃莉诺，你太碍眼又太自私了，你选择的路注定是玩火自焚，而你却将一切失败归因于我的操控。
你的王位必然不会长久，这座无归城……也注定会崩溃!
闭嘴，你只需要承认，这一局落败的人是你就好了。
自从被击毙在圣堂牌局那日起，她无处排解的怨恨，不甘，终于得以在这一刻释放。
我证明了，赢到最后的人是我，我配得上我自己的野心和欲望……
而你，拉斐尔，像条野狗一样死去吧。
Done with this emotional debate, "Mammon" reaches out and rips the core from Raphael's chest, then crushes it in her fist.
淡金色的玻璃状心脏在她手中化为齑粉，如乱琼碎玉坠落地面，连同着拉斐尔的残躯一起化作光点，随风飘逝。
The Archangel meets her end in silence, utterly destroyed by that overwhelming force, reduced to nothing but wisps of smoke.
You witness it all from behind, along with the raven slowly waking on the throne.
Faced with this mad and terrifyingly powerful new form, you can only manage to stammer out a single question.
无妨，名字对我而言已经不再重要。
Her hand still clenched from crushing Raphael's core, she turns to face you in a silent declaration of the power she now wields.
事已至此，她已经不再需要假面去伪装，因此她也没有再逃避自己亲口说出的谎言。
灰鸦，你是我至今为止遇到的，唯一没有背叛我的人，所以我愿意补偿你。
和我一起留在这里吧，无归城会为你源源不断的奉上所有，你的一切欲望都会在这里得到满足……
Isn't that better than the endless scheming and betrayal waiting for you out there?
但我们约定好了，要一起去推翻圣堂。
Sorry, but that promise was never meant to be kept.

She gestures toward the skeletal figure enthroned on the crumbling seat of power. The last Mammon died years ago, yet the Golden Law continues its silent work, endlessly funneling the world's treasures here.
Bound by the Golden Law, every Mammon is trapped here for life and condemned to serve as the living heart of that very law within the City of No Return.
我会在这里一直担任无归城的城主，至少——在下一任玛门出现之前。
And you, Gray Raven. I want you here beside me, sharing in all this wealth, savoring the ultimate fulfillment of every desire.
可这就是一个陷阱!这里就丁点大窄地，待在这里一辈子跟坐牢有什么分别!
Morigan cuts in, shattering the illusion of paradise with harsh reality.
If you choose to stay, you'll just become another gravestone in this city of the dead.
你会不再是那个为了欺骗全世界，可以赌上一切的莉莉丝。
You mean I'm trapping myself? Honestly, I don't care. This crown has finally satisfied the hunger that's been gnawing at me all this time.
环视着这座巨大的瓶中城，曾经来时感觉迂回复杂的回廊，如今站在王座旁看去，也不过是一眼可以尽收于眼底的构造。
在无归城的每一个角落里，都燃烧着永不熄灭的炼狱熔炉，从火焰中不断吐出着金澄澄的玛门币。

Through the Golden Law's workings, these coins flow out into every purse across the world. Generation after generation, each Golden King has wielded this very system to control the economic heartbeat of the Scorched Borderland.
She feels a pang of loneliness thinking about the life ahead, but what swells stronger in her chest is something else entirely. It's the deep satisfaction of finally having found her sanctuary.
曾经的我在外界被欺骗，被驱逐，但只有在这里，一切都尽在我掌心中。
If this is what makes me happy... then tell me, why shouldn't I stay?
But you'll end up just like that pile of bones sitting on the throne.
Pile of bones? Tell me, Gray Raven, what makes you and me so different?
站在王座旁，她回过头，直直地望向那位向自己发出质问的人类。
You know... I've always been curious about what drives you. What desires are you hiding?
You raise your palm, and you and the raven are instantly seized by an invisible force, yanked violently into the air.
在他们的下方，一个褐红色的圆洞从虚空中划开，并很快拓成能容纳人类通过的大小，如血盘大口般迎接着一人一鸟的进入。
黄金之王勾起手指，打开了无尽幻境的入口，自身则在王座上缓缓坐下。
像你这般正直，诚实，几乎从不为自身目的而行动的人类……
I wonder what you'll look like once I peel away that veneer of moral restraint?
Her expression has grown unnervingly calm, stripped of the polished, fake smile she once wore like a mask.
In that fleeting moment, you catch a glimpse of the true essence beneath, the person who was once Lilith, once the Famine Knight.
A kindness carefully hidden beneath layers of lies and deception, fragile and faint, yet undeniably real.
Like a coal buried beneath layers of snow, hidden yet searing hot, dissolving into steam the instant it's discovered.
但还没等人类思考清楚这其中到底代表着什么，她又已经不留一丝情面地，将自己的曾经血契者和渡鸦一起扔进了洞口中。
去吧，将你的所有都展现给我看。
Clutching the raven close to your chest, you plummet through endless darkness.
The chasm stretches endlessly downward. It feels like you are tumbling through a rabbit's burrow for ages, spinning and falling until finally slamming headfirst into the rocky walls below.
捂着被撞得生痛的脑袋，人类支撑着疲惫的身体爬起身，才发现这个洞穴居然远比自己想象的宏大——
一排排环状的，规则的建筑如路标在旷野上陈列着，空洞的架构其中没有任何能容纳人类在内部生活起居的设施，但它仅仅只是默然地，没有任何规律地存在着。
Beyond these structures, the world offers nothing but silence. No wind stirs the air, no rain breaks the stillness, no plants rustle, and no creatures cry out.
This place seems to exist outside the bounds of natural law, governed by its own mysterious principles.
嘎，那小妮子真够忘恩负义的，我们帮了她那么多，她就这么把我们一脚踹进来!
Morigan follows you, yelling at the usual volume, but even its familiar squawking sounds extra loud against the oppressive silence.
人类往前探索了一段路，试着发现更多，但建筑内部没有任何痕迹残留，就像它不知道为何会被建立一样，这个世界拒绝向外来者揭示任何谜团。
试着往墙面上敲了敲，没有抖落任何粉尘，甚至没有传出任何回音，墙体本身好像就拒绝自身存在的形态被改变。
A rare visitor... First time in the Infinite Illusion Realm?
回答问题的却是一声怪里怪气的答腔，人类回过头，只见一道看不清样貌的黑影在空中悬浮着。
Oh my! You actually still have a face. Now that's unusual! I've got to tell Mammon right away. What an unusual guest!
看到人类的五官，对面黑影泛起一股诡异的兴奋，音调都拔高了几分。
Sorry, but could you tell me where exactly this is...?
Here? This is my Spiral Graveyard. I was curious what it'd look like to line up buildings like this along a street, so I just went ahead and built it.
对啊，你不知道吗?规则都不知道就进来了?
The shadow freezes, then bursts into sharp, unending laughter.
哈哈哈哈，天呐，大新闻，必须回去告诉所有人，这次真的是一桩大新闻——!
In the dead silence, his piercing laughter spirals upward through the architecture, echoing endlessly until it merges into one chaotic resonance.
在笑够了之后，他终于有心思去解释这股莫名其妙的笑意是从何而来了。
Friend, let me tell you something. This is your life's top moment, a once-in-a-lifetime miracle that'll never happen again. The Supreme Heaven just showed you some serious mercy.
Welcome to the Infinite Illusion Realm, a paradise where your every wish can come true. Here, anything and everything is possible... except bringing your Maria back to life.
